title: SWF: DefineBitsLossless2 for bitmap library items
description: When compiling a document with BitmapItem library items that have dataUri, emit DefineBitsLossless2 (tag 36) tags for each bitmap. Parse the PNG/GIF data URI, encode as ARGB32 pixels with zlib compression, write the tag. Also emit DefineBitsJPEG3 (tag 35) for JPEG images. Tests: a doc with a small bitmap library item compiles to a SWF containing tag 36 (lossless) or 35 (JPEG).
